mission: Ben wakes the three survivors. First impressions: Sera (disciplined, intense, formal), Torin (warm, commanding, disarming), Kael (quiet, watchful, wary). The disorientation of waking after a thousand years.
why_now: The containment system is failing; the survivors are the only source of context for what the fortress contains and why
conflict: The survivors are disoriented, hostile to varying degrees, and speak in archaic patterns. Sera demands identification and chain of command. Torin assesses Ben tactically. Kael says nothing and watches everyone.
turning_point: Sera recognizes Ben's Jedi training but not his era. 'What year is it?' The answer staggers all three.
opening_hook: Ben's hand on the stasis release feels like a choice he can't take back. The first chamber's field dissolves, and a woman with the bearing of a soldier opens eyes that have been closed for a thousand years.
closing_hook: Torin is the last to orient. He looks at the nine dark chambers, the empty one, and says quietly: 'Who got out?'
emotional_trajectory: Tense anticipation -> the shock of contact across centuries -> growing dread as scope becomes apparent

stakes.personal: Ben has just assumed responsibility for three people a millennium out of time
stakes.interpersonal: The survivors' immediate trust dynamics — Sera demanding, Torin assessing, Kael retreating
stakes.external: These people are the only ones who understand what the fortress contains

setting: Fortress Level 3 — Stasis Ring, emergency lighting, the three active chambers
sensory_details: Stasis fields collapsing with a sound like held breath released; Sera's Force presence — sharp, disciplined, ancient-feeling; Torin's — warm but heavy, something wrong underneath; Kael's — clipped, guarded, trained differently; the wrongness resonating through them all
canon_elements_needed: Millennium of temporal displacement effects on Force-sensitives
Jedi Lords era training versus modern Jedi training differences
Force presence perception of ancient practitioners by modern Jedi
Archaic Basic language and communication across eras
Stasis revival procedures and physiological recovery
promises_planted: Sera's formal distance from Ben will thaw (PP15)
notes: Arc transition for Ben: his lie_reinforced phase begins — the survivors' dependence on him confirms his belief that the burden is his to carry. Sera, Torin, Kael arcs all begin at lie_established. Survivor speech patterns: Sera speaks in complete sentences under stress — formal, precise, military. Torin's warmth has an archaic courtesy to it. Kael waits to be addressed — his silence is itself archaic.
